guarantees.claim: update_seckey_inprocess is 1 when cfg_block is true and at least one reg2hw.key[i].qe bit is set, else 0.

assumptions.claim: The reg2hw.key unpacked array has exactly 32 entries, matching the loop bound of 32.
assumptions.risk: If array size differs, the loop may access out-of-bounds indices or ignore key entries, causing incomplete detection.

uncertain_points.claim: update_seckey_inprocess is a glitch-prone combinational OR of cfg_block and key qe bits; if cfg_block deasserts before all key qualifier bits clear, the signal may fall prematurely.
uncertain_points.cond: cfg_block deasserts while any reg2hw.key[i].qe is still high
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream logic may prematurely exit key-update processing, leading to incomplete secret key handling.

uncertain_points.claim: The loop bound is a hardcoded literal 32; if the actual reg2hw.key array size is parameterized differently, this block will be incorrect.
uncertain_points.risk: Mis-indexing or incomplete key qualifier status detection.
